program_version.source_prose: The completion of all the requirements in one of the mathematics major options listed below. ... Option A, Standard Mathematics (Curriculum Code 640). In addition to the requirements above, to complete the standard mathematics major a student must pass eight 300- to 400-level mathematics courses, excluding 01:640:491,492.

requirements.name: Mathematics Major (Option A, Standard Mathematics)
requirements.source_prose: The requirements for a math major are as follows:

requirements.name: Calculus, Linear Algebra and Differential Equations
requirements.source_prose: Three semesters of calculus (01:640:151-152, and 251 or equivalent), Introductory Linear Algebra (01:640:250), and Elementary Differential Equations (01:640:244 or 01:640:252).

requirements.name: Calculus I
requirements.source_prose: Three semesters of calculus (01:640:151-152, and 251 or equivalent)

requirements.name: Calculus II
requirements.source_prose: Three semesters of calculus (01:640:151-152, and 251 or equivalent)

requirements.name: Multivariable Calculus
requirements.notes: 'or equivalent' is not modeled: the catalog does not say which courses are equivalent.
requirements.source_prose: Three semesters of calculus (01:640:151-152, and 251 or equivalent)

requirements.name: Computing for Mathematics
requirements.notes: The prose names 01:198:107 and permits 01:198:111 or 14:332:252 as substitutes, so all three are eligible. Wherever a course is absent from the loaded SOC terms (14:332:252 is absent from the development database) it is reported unresolved rather than created.
requirements.source_prose: 01:198:107 Computing for Mathematics and the Sciences with a grade of C or better. (01:198:111 Introduction to Computer Science or 14:332:252 Programming Methodology I may be substituted for 01:198:107.)

requirements.name: Upper-Level Mathematics (eight courses)
requirements.notes: 'including one of 01:640:311,312, 411-412, and one of 01:640:350, 351, 451-452' is encoded as two categories that the eight courses must jointly cover (min_distinct_categories=2). AMBIGUITY for a human reviewer: '411-412' and '451-452' may denote two-semester SEQUENCES that count only as a pair; this encoding accepts either course of the pair on its own. The prose attaches the analysis/algebra clause to the courses taken at Rutgers-New Brunswick; the location part is not evaluable (see MATH_RESIDENCY).
requirements.source_prose: to complete the standard mathematics major a student must pass eight 300- to 400-level mathematics courses, excluding 01:640:491,492. ... At least four of the upper-level courses used to complete the major must be taken at Rutgers University-New Brunswick, including one of 01:640:311,312, 411-412, and one of 01:640:350, 351, 451-452.

program_rules.name: Minimum four upper-level mathematics courses at Rutgers-New Brunswick
program_rules.not_evaluable_reason: The rule requires knowing which courses were taken AT Rutgers-New Brunswick. StudentCourse records no transfer provenance, so this cannot be checked.
program_rules.source_prose: At least four of the upper-level courses used to complete the major must be taken at Rutgers University-New Brunswick
